output.summary: A large deciduous maple native to Central Europe and Western Asia, the sycamore maple has a broad, rounded crown, bark that flakes into irregular patches with age, and paired winged seeds that twirl as they fall. Its spring sap has been tapped for a drink and used to make sugar, syrup or beer.
